app.name: Menschheit Arena
app.short: A local, bilingual platform for multi-agent debates and a safe AI security lab.
app.tagline: Debates between machines. Security for humans.
arena.calls_hint: Every call with prompt, response and token counts. Helps with errors and cost control.
arena.delete_confirm: Delete the debate and all its turns?
arena.detail.bias_high: Notable deviation: the report flags a possible position bias.
arena.detail.bias_ok: Small deviation between the judge passes.
arena.detail.judge_pending: The verdict appears once all rounds are complete.
arena.detail.private_hint: Visible to humans only. The opponent never sees this field.
arena.detail.title: Debate transcript
arena.error: The debate could not be loaded.
arena.fork_hint: Copies models and settings but starts a new topic. The old debate stays untouched.
arena.form.demo_topic: Should humanity hand control over general AI to a democratic institution?
arena.form.models_hint: In demo mode the names are ignored. In live mode they must match the configured provider.
arena.form.note: Agents only see anonymised public contributions. Private reasoning is archived and invisible to the opponent.
arena.form.title: New debate
arena.form.topic_placeholder: e.g. Should humanity delegate control over general AI to a democratic institution?
arena.history.empty: No debate yet. Start the first one above.
arena.history.title: Previous debates
arena.lead: Start a structured debate. Without an API key, a deterministic demo runs real workflows, real state transitions and a complete report.
arena.private_hidden_hint: Hidden because it is disabled in the settings.
arena.prompt_hint: Shows exactly what was sent to the model and what came back.
arena.title: Debate arena
arena.transcript_hint: Full conversation: topic, turns, moderation, verdict.
banner.ai_act: AI transparency under Art. 50 EU AI Act: You are reading and generating content with AI systems. Automated output can be wrong. Verify every decision before you rely on it.
common.name: Name
config.confidence_gate_hint: Confidence at which a side counts as convinced. Default 25.
config.early_stop_hint: If enabled, the moderator may stop before the round limit on genuine consensus.
config.lead: These values apply per debate and override the defaults.
config.provider_hint: Provider, base URL and model names apply to this debate.
config.rounds_hint: Rounds are freely selectable from 1 to 2000. The transcript shows every round.
config.show_reasoning_hint: Reveal the private scratchpad in the transcript. For your own analysis only.
config.title: Fine-tuning
hero.demo_badge: Demo mode: no API key required
hero.lead: Two models argue pro and contra. A moderator prevents false consensus. An independent judge scores the transcript twice in reversed order. The result is a verifiable Markdown report – not a feel-good chat.
hero.title: Argue first. Verify second. Build third.
nav.label: Main navigation
provider.custom_hint: Custom endpoint: enter base URL and model names yourself. OpenAI compatible.
provider.key_hint: The key is stored locally only and never returned to the UI.
provider.label: Provider
provider.lead: Pick a provider. Free models carry the :free suffix. Custom endpoints are available via "Custom".
provider.save_hint: Stores the choice as default for new debates. Existing .env is backed up.
provider.saved: Default saved. The .env file was updated.
provider.title: Model selection
report.disclaimer: This report is a research and learning artefact. It is not legal, security or investment advice. AI output can be wrong, incomplete or manipulated.
report.method_value: Isolated opening position, anonymised steelman rounds, anti-sycophancy moderator, dual-order judge, Markdown archive.
report.no_active_execution: No active scans or exploits were executed.
report.title: Debate report
sentinel.actions.empty: No actions yet. Generate a plan.
sentinel.actions.title: Actions
sentinel.detail.actions_hint: Read-only actions are not executed. Active actions require documented approval.
sentinel.detail.findings_hint: Findings only appear in the report after human verification.
sentinel.detail.kill_confirm: Activate the kill switch? All proposed and approved actions will be rejected.
sentinel.detail.title: Engagement details
sentinel.finding.title: Title
sentinel.finding.verified: I have verified this finding as a human.
sentinel.findings.title: Verified findings
sentinel.form.approver_placeholder: Full name of the approving person
sentinel.form.roe_hint: The RoE is stored locally and only as a hash. It is never sent to the LLM.
sentinel.form.roe_placeholder: Signed authorisation, test window, out-of-scope, emergency contacts …
sentinel.form.scope_hint: Allowed are IPs, CIDR, domains, wildcards and http(s) URLs. Public targets are blocked by default.
sentinel.form.title: New engagement
sentinel.lead: The control plane for authorised security testing: capture the RoE, enforce scope, propose actions, require human approval, audit everything. Active attacks are intentionally not implemented.
sentinel.list.empty: No engagement yet. Create the first one above.
sentinel.list.title: Engagements
sentinel.no_execution: Execution disabled: the control plane only records proposals and approvals.
sentinel.report_note: The report contains only human-verified findings.
sentinel.title: Sentinel Lab
sentinel.validate.lead: Check a target against an allowlist without creating an engagement.
sentinel.validate.title: Scope quick check
sentinel.warning: Security boundary: this module does not run scans, exploits or write actions. It enforces scope and approvals before a separate, isolated worker would ever be allowed to start.
system.integrations_hint: Hermes, LiteLLM and custom workers use the same REST API. Details in docs/HERMES.md.
system.lead: Runtime status, boundaries and integration points.
system.live_note: Live mode: requests go to the configured provider. DPA, zero-data-retention and EU processing must be clarified before using customer data.
system.mock_note: Demo mode: all LLM responses are generated deterministically on this machine. No data leaves the host.
system.provider_hint: Provider and API key are configured through .env or the setup wizard.
system.title: System
system.token: App token (only if APP_ACCESS_TOKEN is set)
system.token_hint: The token is stored only in this browser's localStorage and sent as X-App-Token on write requests.
